name: Potions as a bonus action
author: Alexandria
summary: Drinking a potion yourself is a bonus action. Feeding one to someone else is still an action.

rules.term: Potions as a bonus action (house rule)
rules.text: Drinking a potion **yourself** takes a **bonus action**. Giving a potion to another creature takes an **action**, as normal.

assistant.dm: At this table drinking a potion yourself is a bonus action; giving one to someone else is an action.
assistant.player: At this table drinking a potion yourself is a bonus action, so the player can still attack or cast on the same turn. Giving one to an ally is an action.
